title: A WRITTEN-OFF loan credits LOSSES_WRITTEN_OFF and debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY for a capitalized-income amortization (loan 21 L131: CREDIT account 13 100.00, DEBIT account 23 100.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a CAPITALIZED_INCOME_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan that is WRITTEN OFF (not charged off), on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_360_30_INTEREST_RECALC_DAILY_CAPITALIZED_INCOME) at the amortization transaction L131. request.capitalized_income_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 131 (externalId 79842d5a-6244-48b9-91bb-36657c2f5718, type loanTransactionType.capitalizedIncomeAmortization): interestPortion 100.0 -> "10000" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan read-back carries a NON-REVERSED writeOff transaction id 130 (externalId 94bfb529-c050-4876-b569-ea0c7359e1d3) dated on the amortization date and with a LOWER id, so request...written_off is true; the loan is NOT charged off and its fraud flag is false. request...accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_360_30_INTEREST_RECALC_DAILY_CAPITALIZED_INCOME.json: incomeFromCapitalizationAccountId 6, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 23, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 14, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 12, writeOffAccountId 13. expect...legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L131 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 318 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 13 amount 100.0 and id 319 DEBIT glAccountId 23 amount 100.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a written-off loan's amortization credits LOSSES_WRITTEN_OFF (13), not income from capitalization (6), and debits the same total to deferred income liability. It is the account cell that discriminates the ignore-loan-state drive. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive fee portion (zero here), the charged-off and fraud arms (this loan is written off and neither charged off nor fraud), and the classification / charge-off-reason branches (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, account and expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
